# Coding Agent

Coding Agent dresses Obsidian as a coding agent and switches between the warm coral identity of Claude Code and the cool teal identity of OpenAI Codex. It reskins the whole chrome, from titlebar and tabs to sidebars, file tree, status bar and scrollbars, through a single accent engine, and adds a recents-style explorer with activity dots and a color-coded heading ladder.

![Coding Agent screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/brightwav3/Coding-Agent-Theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue

    modes: ["dark", "light"]

Reskin the entire chrome—titlebar, tabs, sidebars, file tree, status bar and scrollbars—use a single accent engine to repaint the UI, add a recents-style explorer with activity dots and a color-coded heading ladder."
